        #   - CC != HOSTCC then makes install-extmod-build rebuild the host programs in the target directory with $CC, like it does for cross builds.
        docker run --rm -v "$PWD:$PWD" -w "$PWD" debian:bookworm-slim sh -ec "
        apt-get -q update
        DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get --no-install-recommends -qq install make gcc libc6-dev libssl-dev
        make run-command KBUILD_RUN_COMMAND='+\$(MAKE) HOSTCC=gcc-12 \$(build)=scripts/basic'
        srctree=. SRCARCH=arm64 CC=gcc-12 HOSTCC=gcc MAKE=make sh scripts/package/install-extmod-build 'debian/linux-headers-quartz64/usr/src/linux-headers-$kernelrelease'
        "
